limitations: The result does not settle the general PDE-singleton determinacy question; it requires finite ray fibers, and the algebraic corollary assumes a zero set avoiding the origin. It is nonquantitative and does not cover algebraic supports with a radial-line component.
provenance: Scientific sources and proof evidence are documented in RESULT.md and the dated audit files.
record_title: Finite ray fibers remove the injectivity hypothesis in algebraic complex-moment extensions
